class.name: NNBooleanSensor
class.brief_description: Accepts a boolean value and scales it to [code]0..1[/code] range.
class.description: Converts [member boolean_value] to a float [member NNSensors.sensor_value] when evaluated: [code]false[/code] maps to [code]0.0[/code] and [code]true[/code] maps to [code]1.0[/code].

members.member: Boolean input for the sensor. Evaluates [member NNSensors.sensor_value] to [code]1.0[/code] when [code]true[/code] and [code]0.0[/code] when [code]false[/code].
